premise: A new flying machine arrives in the pod with propellers — no use without air — and Engineer swaps them for little thrusters, so the drone flies its own way.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Tortoise and the Eagle' (wanting to fly the way others do), turned: you fly your own way.
lesson: There's more than one way to fly.
learning: Propellers need air to push on, so a drone on the Moon flies with little thruster puffs.

en-US.title: The Drone Without Propellers
en-US.text: {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:live} The supply pod popped open. Inside, packed in foam, was a brand-new flying machine with four little propellers. {engineer:enter} {engineer:face happy} [excited] Let's see you fly! said Engineer. The propellers spun up. Whirrrr. {engineer:face surprised} It didn't rise one bit. Propellers push against air, and the Moon has none. [sad] The propellers drooped. {engineer:face normal} Hmm, said Engineer. {engineer:live hold} Off came the propellers. On went four tiny thrusters. One last hard turn of the wrench… {engineer:live resume} {robot:enter} {robot:face surprised} Robot held his breath, even though he doesn't breathe. {sfx:puff} Puff. Puff-puff. {drone:float loop 0.4} And up it went — a real Moon {drone:enter} drone, bobbing on little puffs of gas. {engineer:face happy} {robot:hop x2} Its very first photo? {drone:live} Engineer, grinning from ear to ear.

es-ES.title: El dron sin hélices
es-ES.text: {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:live} La cápsula de carga se abrió. Dentro, envuelto en espuma, había un aparato volador nuevecito con cuatro hélices. {engineer:enter} {engineer:face happy} [excited] ¡A ver cómo vuelas! dijo Ingeniera. Las hélices empezaron a girar. Zzzzzz. {engineer:face surprised} No se levantó ni un poquito. Las hélices empujan el aire, y en la Luna no hay. [sad] Las hélices se quedaron mustias. {engineer:face normal} Mmm, dijo Ingeniera. {engineer:live hold} Fuera hélices. Dentro, cuatro propulsores diminutos. Una última vuelta fuerte de la llave… {engineer:live resume} {robot:enter} {robot:face surprised} Robot contuvo la respiración, aunque no respira. {sfx:puff} Puf. Puf, puf. {drone:float loop 0.4} Y arriba que fue: un {drone:enter} dron lunar de verdad, subiendo a soplidos de gas. {engineer:face happy} {robot:hop x2} ¿Su primera foto? {drone:live} Ingeniera, sonriendo de oreja a oreja.

puff.prompt: three tiny puffs from a small gas thruster, soft and airy, cute
